This page contains the weekly Google Colab notebooks used during lectures.

Students must always:

1. Open the weekly notebook
2. Go to **File → Save a copy in Drive**
3. Rename the notebook using the correct format
4. Complete the activity
5. Submit the notebook link when required

---

# Important Rule

Do **not** edit the master notebook directly.

Always save your own copy first.

---

# Weekly Live Notebooks

| Week | Topic | Notebook |
|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | Orientation and First Python Code | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK1_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 2 | Setup and First Dataset | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK2_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 3 | Python Fundamentals | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK3_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 4 | Data Handling with Pandas | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK4_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 5 | Statistics and Visualization | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK5_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 6 | Interactive Dashboards | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK6_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 7 | Regression Analysis | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK7_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 8 | Machine Learning Foundations | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK8_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 9 | Classification Models | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK9_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 10 | Clustering and Unsupervised Learning | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK10_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 11 | Forecasting and Time Series | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK11_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 12 | NLP and Generative AI | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK12_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |
| Week 13 | Capstone Analytics Project | [Open Notebook](PASTE_WEEK13_COLAB_LINK_HERE) |

---

# Notebook Naming Convention

Students must rename notebooks as follows:

```text
WeekNumber_IndexNumber_Name.ipynb
```

Example:

```text
Week03_2024BA12345_Perera.ipynb
```

---

# Submission Reminder

When submitting a notebook:

1. Click **Share**
2. Change access to **Anyone with the link**
3. Set permission to **Viewer**
4. Copy the link
5. Submit through the weekly activity/submission page

---

# Troubleshooting

## Notebook does not open

Make sure you are signed into your Google account.

## Cannot edit notebook

You are probably viewing the master copy.

Use:

```text
File → Save a copy in Drive
```

## Code does not run

Check:

- internet connection
- runtime status
- spelling mistakes
- whether required libraries are imported

---

# Academic Integrity

Students may use AI tools for support, but all submitted notebooks must include their own understanding, interpretation, and explanation.

Submitting copied code without understanding is not acceptable.
